commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

provider.description: The provider; the environment's first when absent.

label.description: An account's label: 1 to 200 characters on one line, with no space at either end; unique on its environment ignoring case, preset to the email the account signed in as.

nameByEmail.description: Set only for an automatically supplied name, to become the email after sign-in.
